Game Overview

In Mani Mouse 2, the core idea is straightforward: guide an adventurous mouse through challenging 2D landscapes in Mani Mouse 2. With perilous traps, cunning enemy cats, and collectible cheese slices, each level demands strategic timing and skillful double jumps to conquer. Dive into this fun and charming platformer, where every stage offers a new, thrilling escapade.
